instrumentation: perf_counter around actual queued CPU kernel execution, grouped by original entry name; construction, compilation, checkpoint force rebuild and diagnostics excluded from step timing
comparison: Existing Metal preparation telemetry, first and latest available 1000-step windows. Same original geometry, different trajectory points and pressure controller; observational estimate, not an isolated matched-device benchmark.
